_comment: Development set — used for tuning chunk size, top-k, thresholds and prompts. It is separate from rag-eval.json, but rag-eval was used for course acceptance and informed early design analysis, so neither set is presented as a strict unseen benchmark. Topics here cover handbook sections the acceptance/regression set does not touch (waitlists, academic standing, repeating courses, changing major, schedule conflicts, security), plus casual and Chinese phrasings that its formal English questions do not exercise. Every `must_contain` string is verbatim in the corpus — verified with grep. `must_contain` 用于检查【检索】是否捞到了正确原文（整句，逐字取自语料）；`answer_any_of` 用于检查【答案】是否落地（短 token，跨语言可用）—— 中文回答里不会出现英文原句，两者必须分开判。 `ref` 是给 LLM-as-judge 用的完整标准答案；`must_contain` 只用于检索判定。两者不能混用 —— 拿 must_contain 当 ref 会让裁判既误伤完整答案(多说了)，又把真实的检索失败误判为正确拒答。
_split: dev — tune freely on this set

items.q: What happens if the course I want is already full?
items.ref: Your enrolment attempt is placed on the waitlist. If a seat frees up the next student on the list is enrolled automatically and notified by email.

items.q: Can I enrol in two courses that overlap in time?
items.must_contain: not** be enrolled in two courses whose schedules overlap
items.ref: No. You may not be enrolled in two courses whose schedules overlap, even partially. Drop the existing course first.

items.q: I got an F. Can I take the course again?
items.expected_source_section: §7 Repeating a course or FAQ Q8
items.ref: Yes. A D or F grade may be repeated once. The new grade replaces the old one in the GPA, but both attempts stay on the transcript.

items.q: Can I switch to a different major?
items.ref: Yes, once per academic year. Submit a change-of-major form to the Academic Advising Office.

items.q: When does the university put a student on academic probation?
items.ref: Academic probation applies when the cumulative GPA is between 1.0 and 1.5. The student's credit load is then capped at 13 credits for the next semester.
items._note: 参考答案曾误写为「低于 2.0」——那是 academic warning 的区间。系统答对了，是我的 ref 错了。

items.q: How long does a refund take to arrive?
items.ref: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within ten working days.

items.q: Is my password stored in plain text?
items.ref: No. Only a hashed and salted version is stored; the plaintext is never logged.

items.q: Where do I see my weekly timetable?
items.ref: In "My Schedule" in the portal — a weekly grid of your enrolled courses with meeting days and times.

items.q: how many creditz can i do in one semestr
items.expected_source_section: §2 Credit load — casual phrasing with typos
items.ref: Between 12 and 18 credits per semester. Above 18 requires a GPA of at least 3.5 and written approval from Academic Advising.

items.q: gpa
items.ref: GPA is the credit-weighted average of grade points across graded courses. Withdrawn (W) and incomplete (I) courses are excluded.

items.q: how can i gradute
items.ref: 120 credits, a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0, all required courses for the declared major, and the ENG101 English Composition requirement.

items.q: What are the gradution requirements for a bachelor degree at this university?
items.expected_source_section: §2 Graduation — typo inside a long well-formed sentence
items.ref: 120 credits, a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0, all required major courses, and the ENG101 English Composition requirement.

items.q: 毕业需要多少学分
items.ref: 至少 120 学分，且累计 GPA 不低于 2.0，并完成本专业全部必修课与 ENG101 英语写作要求。

items.q: 我什么时候退课可以拿到全额退款
items.ref: 第 2 周结束前退课可获全额退款。

items.q: 大一新生可以选 CS201 吗
items.ref: 一般不可以。CS201 要求二年级及以上身份、至少修满 30 学分，并已通过 CS101。

items.q: CS101 一共有多少学分
items.ref: CS101 是 3 学分。
